C0902.title: Delta Force Account Theft and Asset Stripping Wave Triggers Emergency Security Measures
C0902.summary: In April 2026, a large number of Delta Force player accounts were compromised, with in-game warehouse items and Havoc Coins looted. The developer urgently deployed an automatic account freeze for abnormal logins and accelerated the development of a secondary password system.
